content.short: Bedrock is a multi-asset liquid restaking protocol designed to maximize the utility and yield of staked assets.
content.description: Bedrock is a sophisticated liquid restaking protocol that enables users to maximize the capital efficiency of their digital assets across multiple ecosystems. By supporting diverse assets like ETH and BTC, Bedrock allows participants to earn native staking rewards while receiving liquid tokens that can be utilized within the broader DeFi landscape. The protocol integrates with leading restaking layers like EigenLayer to provide additional yield opportunities and enhanced network security. Bedrock focuses on providing a secure, institutional-grade infrastructure with a user-friendly interface, ensuring that both retail and professional investors can participate in the next evolution of staking and restaking with full transparency and minimal risk.
content.meta: Bedrock is a premier multi-asset liquid restaking protocol, offering optimized yield and capital efficiency for staked assets across major blockchain networks.
